# Actual legacy schema-six account

Generated by the pre-schema-eight production `createHarnessOptimizationRuntime`
and its original worker/SQLite, using the existing controlled fixture Source
(no Native Main grant). Original run:
`T/d23-budget-account-epoch-api-red.run.json` and `.log`; the temporary archival
step passed while the real epoch-two revision failed `dsh_account_forbidden`.

The fixture contains one account, settled assessment usage (50 tokens / 75
microUSD), and an actual schema-six immutable account revision to Mandate 2
with authorization epoch 1. No business authority is imported from the fixture.
Tests copy the SQLite file into an owned temporary path and call the original
ledger migration/graph methods. They compare the existing immutable revision
row/hash exactly. The historical SQLite owner/root metadata remains original
for provenance; it is not used to open a Main runtime or authenticate that path.

No lifecycle/owner JSON or lock file is shipped.
